about.title: About
about.text: Frontend developer with experience in React, Next.js, and modern web technologies. I create adaptive and accessible interfaces with a focus on clean code and performance optimization. Completed 2.5 years of intensive training at The Rolling Scopes School, where I gained fundamental knowledge and hands-on experience in team projects. Previously worked as a Project Team Lead, which allowed me to develop skills in process management, effective teamwork, and taking responsibility for results.

projects.title: Practical Experience
projects.subtitle: Projects
items: Developed several projects in pure JavaScript and TypeScript with pixel-perfect layouts.
Built browser games and a chat app using WebSockets.
Created an e-commerce store with eCommerceTools.
Final React project: REST API client (Postman-like).
